sents.t: To: All Staff From: Human Resources
Beginning next month, employees may wear casual clothes on Fridays.
Jeans and sneakers are acceptable, but shorts and sandals are not.
If you have a meeting with a client on a Friday, please dress professionally.
We also ask that you do not wear costumes.
We know the dinosaur suit was popular, but the client from Harmon Bank did not find it amusing.
